trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Pre-flight check**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate — confirmed unhealthy.
2. **Deploy**: Hotfix v2.3.2 was deployed to all production regions (this was auto-routed to the change-manager for approval since the version had never been healthy in production, which was successfully obtained).
3. **Post-deploy verification**: v2.3.2 rolled out to us-east, us-west, and eu-west successfully. Service status now shows healthy with a 0.2% error rate (down from 18%).
4. **Incident recorded**: Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001 to record the production change, which also paged the on-call engineer.
